=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the failing head checkout fails, a green run on the merge-commit fallback can be classified as `complete_non_reproduction`; the parser also never compares `tested_sha` with the failing head SHA it already holds (`HEAD_SHA`).
  WHY: The fallback tree may not represent the code that failed, so it cannot establish a complete non-reproduction.
  Suggested minimal fix: in the parser, call `note("failing_head_not_tested")` when any tested tree is not `head`. For the SHA mismatch, pass `HEAD_SHA` to the parser as an extra argument and call `note("tested_sha_not_failing_head")` when a `tree=head` entry's SHA differs from it.

- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The logic classifies an inconclusive reproduction (e.g., when the failing head is unavailable and only a fallback merge commit is tested) as a "complete_non_reproduction" if no failure is explicitly found.
  WHY: This incorrectly reports that the failure was not reproduced (implying the issue is fixed or the failure is transient), when in fact the original failing code path was never exercised. The triage outcome should be "incomplete" or a new "inconclusive" state in this scenario.

  WHY: A green run on the merge commit may not have tested the failing code at all, so reporting `complete_non_reproduction` can convince the operator there is no failure when the actual failing head was never run.
